name: Infinite mossy blocks stamina: every inwall super refills the dash on a moss-only climb
techNote: A 1000-tall Ground-tagged wall (x -50..50) standing on a Moss floor, the finish box on the wall's top. The dot starts on the moss with its back 2 u from the wall's right face and nothing left: no air dash (airDashesLeft 0) and no wall jumps (wallJumpsLeft 0), and the moss floor refills nothing (touchedMossyGround). Every inwall super gives everything back: the wall clip (release with a light flick toward the wall, -0.55, while Velocity.y is under 580) puts the turned hitbox's front ground ray inside the wall, and its hit on a Ground-tagged collider is touchedSolidGround (Movement.cs 2157-2162: airJumpsLeft, airDashesLeft and wallJumpsLeft back to their max); the next tick's dash into the wall with jump on dash frame 1 is a super off that in-wall ground (805 up, 876 momentum into the wall), 3 ticks turned back (+1) and 6 at rest leave the dot clip-ready again 150 u higher. Six loops of 13 ticks climb the wall, the finish box on tick 86. Offline control: the same inputs on the wall tagged Moss clip (onGround) but get no dash back, no dash happens and the dot slides down the moss wall to the floor.
